scenes.headline: Four voices, one script.
scenes.body: Listen to each, then pick a number.
scenes.voiceover: This is a voice test for Mzansi Money Matters. You'll hear four voices read the same lines. Pick the one you like best.

scenes.headline: Luke, South African, livelier
scenes.voiceover: Voice 1. In December two thousand and one, Enron filed for bankruptcy. More than seventy-four billion dollars in shareholder value disappeared. And the warning signs had been there for years.
